newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-MIM says Phil Wright to leave company.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-MIM says Phil Wright to leave company.

text.p: MIM Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday Phil Wright, general manager of the company's main mine the Mount Isa base metals mine in Queensland, is to leave the company.
MIM said Wright joined MIM in 1993 and moved to Mount Isa in January 1995 when the operations there were experiencing great difficulties.
The mine was subject to rolling strokes by the workers during 1995.

It said Stephen O'Donnell general manager commercial at Mount Isa had been appointed executive general manager Mount Isa business unit. O'Donnell was previously general manager of MIM's copper refinery in Townsville, Queensland.
MIM shares closed two cents lower at A$1.77 on Monday.
